mutually_exclusive_paths.conflict: Q3 (Fire Circle ground truth) vs manual review for Q4
mutually_exclusive_paths.resolution: If Q3 validates Fire Circle (85%+ accuracy), use it for Q4 stratification ground truth. If Q3 shows 60-75%, use manual review for Q4. If Q3 fails (<50%), abandon Fire Circle for classification tasks.

mutually_exclusive_paths.conflict: Q2 (API validation) timing vs Q3 (Fire Circle usage)
mutually_exclusive_paths.resolution: Q2 should ideally complete before Q3 to ensure reliable Fire Circle execution, but Q3 can proceed with risk of API failures requiring retry.

complementary_paths.reasoning: Q1 validates prompt on 20 samples, Q4 tests generalization on 100 samples. Sequential dependency - Q4 needs Q1's validated prompt.
Q2 ensures Fire Circle infrastructure reliable before Q3 tests Fire Circle capability. Can run Q2 in parallel with Q1, then Q3.
Both test different aspects of Fire Circle value (recommendation quality vs deliberative consensus). Results inform Fire Circle's role in research program.
